title: Slimage — Compress your images instantly
why_reduce_1: Faster websites — smaller images load instantly and improve SEO.
why_reduce_2: Less storage usage — save space on servers, clouds and devices.
why_reduce_3: Better performance — apps and galleries open faster.
why_reduce_4: Quicker sharing — upload and send images much faster.
why_reduce_5: Lower bandwidth — ideal for mobile users and slow networks.
faq_a1: This tool compresses and optionally converts your images to modern formats like WebP to reduce file size while keeping visual quality.
faq_a2: Yes. You can compress images in their original format or convert them to WebP for even smaller file sizes.
faq_a3: Smaller images mean faster websites, better UX, improved SEO, lower bandwidth usage and smoother galleries or apps.
faq_a4: All processing happens on your own server. No third‑party services receive your files, keeping everything private.
faq_q5: What is WebP and when should I use it?
faq_a5: WebP is a modern image format that offers much better compression than JPG or PNG. Use it for web, apps and any place where performance matters.
